excludedSources.reason: Stateful adapter owning useFullBoard and stateful view containers; receives a pure presentation seam per FUIR-LOCK-12 (Wave 2).
Container composing TaskDetailPanelSurface with card-detail state and actions.
Container composing ItemPageSurface with the item, board and access reads, the item commands and the refused-write state.
Stateful view adapter owning the calendar board query state, route filter and writes, composing the registered calendar surface.
Stateful view adapter owning kanban board query state and composing registered board surfaces.
Stateful view adapter owning table main query state and composing registered table surfaces.
Stateful view adapter owning the timeline board query state, the window and the writes, composing the registered timeline surface.
Container hosting the shared item side sheet for a page that is not a Board view: it reads the item's Board and access and wires the sheet's actions, composing the registered item sheet surface.
Container composing BoardSettingsSurface with the settings, board and access reads, every settings write and the Kanban view's own settings through useBoardView.
Container composing ItemCreateHost with the board read (useFullBoard) for a page that shows one board.
Container composing ItemCreateDialog with the board facts, the create command, the follow-up field writes and the result toasts.
Container composing BoardTrashSheet with the board trash read and the restore command (useBoardTrash).
Stateful hook owning the delete, move, duplicate, remind, complete and unarchive requests, their commands and toasts, and rendering the registered delete, move, duplicate and remind dialogs.
Container reading and writing the pages linked to an item (useItemLinkedPages, useLinkablePages) and owning the page picker and the unlink confirmation.

Container composing SavedFiltersMenu with the saved-filter read and writes (useSavedFilters, useSavedFilterWrites) and the delete-with-undo toast; the filter bars of the table, Kanban and calendar views host it.

Containers composing the forms surfaces with the form, board, access and response reads and every form write (useBoardForms, useForm, useFormSubmissions, useFormWrites, useSubmitForm), the undo wait of a decision on a response and the shared add-item dialog for "create item from response".

notApplicable.reason: The shell renders whatever child view content it receives; per-view loading presentation is owned by the dedicated loading surfaces.
The shell renders whatever child view content it receives; per-view error presentation is owned by the dedicated unavailable surfaces.
The shell composes static chrome around child content and carries no data-driven values of its own.
The tab set is a fixed constant list of view types, not data-driven text; there are no data-shape edges to stress.
No product-authoritative read-only contract exists for board view tabs at this baseline.
Board access gives one read-only presentation for commenters and viewers (no drag, no add), evidenced by ReadOnly; there is no partially permitted Kanban state.
Column content arrives already resolved from the board query; board-level loading is owned by wm.kanban.loading.

Board-level fetch failure is evidenced by wm.kanban.unavailable Error.
High-density board input is evidenced by wm.kanban.board HighDensity with the documented 8x40 cardinality.
No product-authoritative read-only contract exists for kanban cards at this baseline.
No product-authoritative permission-limited capability contract exists for kanban cards at this baseline.
